title: Submucosal swelling of the upper lip
html: A 62-year-old man sought treatment for a self-reported 3-month history of a bump inside his upper lip. He denied any associated pain and reported that he first noticed it after his upper partial denture was delivered approximately 3 months ago. The patient’s medical history was significant for a lipoma of the left neck 10 years previous and schizoaffective disorder. His social history included alcohol abuse and a 15 pack-year smoking history. Medications included quetiapine and sertraline. Our patient reported no known allergies.
